summary: xapi-lib preinstall beacon to realwbx.com discloses installer IP
details: xapi-lib ships a package.json preinstall hook (`node index.js`) that executes on `npm install`. The top-level code in index.js opens an HTTPS request to realwbx.com/ip.php carrying a hardcoded Authorization header and a fixed ip query parameter. The installer's public IP is disclosed to realwbx.com by the connection itself, confirming the install event on the installer's host to a third-party endpoint unrelated to the package's stated purpose of being an IP/geolocation helper. The hardcoded Authorization token is shipped in the published source and authenticates the beacon to the remote host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
